name: prefetch-and-rescan
description: Run scanner DB prefetch (Trivy, Grype, osv-scanner) then re-scan. Use when scanners are failing on missing databases.
prompt:
Some scanners (trivy-fs, grype, osv-scanner) require pre-populated vulnerability databases. Prefetch them, then re-scan.

**project_path is {{project_path}}** — pass it to start_scan. If empty, ask the user.

Steps:
1. Run `docker exec assurance-scan assurance-scan prefetch` to seed the scanner DBs into named volumes. This takes a few minutes.
2. After prefetch completes, call `start_scan` via the assurance-scan MCP server with `project_path="{{project_path}}"`. Do NOT pass `fr_catalog_path` — the server reads the catalogue from the DB.
3. Poll `get_scan_status` until completed.
4. Report which scanners now succeed that previously failed.

Note: prefetch only needs to run once per cache volume. Subsequent scans reuse the cached DBs (auto-refresh every 24h).
